IT Support Engineer 
 Located in Bucharest, Romania 
 Join Yokogawa Romania as an IT Support Engineer in Bucharest. In this hands-on role, you will help colleagues resolve everyday IT issues and keep our local IT infrastructure reliable, secure, and available.
 You will work with colleagues across the business, international IT teams, and external service providers, combining end-user support with infrastructure administration, IT security, and business continuity. The position also includes Data Protection Officer (DPO) responsibilities, covering data protection advice, compliance monitoring, and awareness activities.
 Objectives of this role 
Maintain reliable, secure, and continuous operation of workstations, servers, networks, and peripheral equipment.
Provide efficient end-user support in line with agreed service levels.
Maintain IT security in accordance with internal policies and ISO 27001 requirements.
Support business continuity and disaster recovery planning, implementation, and testing.
Maintain accurate, up-to-date, and traceable IT asset records.
Support compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and promote IT security and data protection awareness.
 Key responsibilities 
 End-User Support & IT Administration 
Provide technical support to employees, troubleshoot IT incidents, and coordinate resolution with relevant IT teams and external providers.
Install, configure, and update Windows operating systems and software applications.
Administer workstations, virtual machines, software licenses, user accounts, and access rights.
Support access to local and external servers, telephony, printers, and other peripheral equipment.
Configure access cards and maintain associated access permissions.
Administer endpoints through Microsoft Intune: device enrollment (Windows Autopilot), configuration and compliance policies, application deployment, update management, and remote actions (wipe, retire, reset).
Manage mobile devices through Intune, including app protection policies.
Administer Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 (user accounts, groups, licenses, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint).
Execute joiner-mover-leaver processes: account creation, equipment handover, access changes, and equipment return.
Support meeting rooms, videoconferencing, and audio-visual equipment.
Record incidents and requests in the ITSM tool, maintain the knowledge base, and report on SLA and ticket KPIs.
 Network, Infrastructure & IT Asset Management 
Configure and monitor the local network and provide LAN, WAN, and VPN support.
Monitor the server room and support the availability of local IT infrastructure.
Define IT equipment specifications, maintain the standard equipment list, and configure and distribute equipment.
Maintain the IT asset inventory, ensuring accuracy and traceability.
Manage project archives and monitor IT resources.
Contribute to preventive maintenance, infrastructure optimization, and equipment standardization.
Manage the hardware lifecycle: procurement support, warranty tracking, and refresh planning.
Coordinate secure data wiping and WEEE-compliant disposal of retired equipment.
Manage relationships with local vendors and service providers (contracts, SLAs, renewals).
Support the validation of backups and perform periodic test restores.
 IT Security & Service Continuity 
Implement internal IT security policies and support the handling of security incidents.
Work with regional and global IT teams to maintain service availability, including infrastructure supporting round-the-clock remote services.
Assess potential infrastructure failures and their impact using Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), keeping assessments up to date.
Participate in the development, implementation, and testing of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans.
Support IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
Deploy and monitor endpoint security controls (EDR, BitLocker, security baselines, Conditional Access, MFA).
Perform regular patch and vulnerability management for operating systems and third-party applications.
Support internal and external ISO 27001 audits by providing evidence and remediating findings.
Maintain backup coverage for the local backup and recovery arrangements and escalate when it falls short.
 Data Protection & GDPR — DPO Responsibilities 
Inform and advise management and employees about GDPR obligations.
Monitor compliance with data protection legislation and internal policies.
Organize data protection training and awareness activities.
Advise on Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and monitor their implementation.
Cooperate with the supervisory authority and act as a contact point.
Assess risks associated with personal data processing and recommend appropriate measures.
Monitor data security measures and support the handling of personal data security incidents.
Support the integration of GDPR requirements into IT and operational processes.
Perform DPO duties independently and advise management on data protection risks.
 Job requirements and skills 
Practical knowledge of Windows workstation administration, software installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Ability to support servers, virtual machines, telephony, printers, and peripheral equipment.
Knowledge of network configuration, monitoring, LAN, WAN, and VPN troubleshooting.
Ability to administer user accounts, access rights, software licenses, and IT asset inventories.
Understanding of IT security practices and ISO 27001-related requirements.
Knowledge of business continuity, disaster recovery, and IT risk assessment, including FMEA.
Knowledge of GDPR and the responsibilities associated with the DPO role, including DPIAs, awareness activities, and personal data incident handling.
Strong troubleshooting, organizational, and documentation skills.
Service-oriented communication and the ability to collaborate with local departments, international IT teams, and external service providers.
Ability to prioritize support requests, take ownership of operational issues, and handle confidential information responsibly.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune (Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance policies, app packaging) and Microsoft Entra ID.
Experience with Microsoft 365 administration.
Experience with an ITSM/ticketing tool and SLA reporting.
Knowledge of endpoint security tooling (Defender, BitLocker) and patch management.
 Important for us 
 For Yokogawa diversity and inclusion is not just a human resources initiative or social to-do. It is something that we strongly believe in and promote. We aim to recruit talent who dare to bring change to our organization with a diverse mindset and refreshing new views.
 Yokogawa wants a Diverse, Equitable, and Inclusive culture. We will actively recruit, develop, and promote people from a variety of backgrounds who differ in terms of experience, knowledge, thinking styles, perspective, cultural background, and socioeconomic status. We will not discriminate based on any categorization of humankind. Yokogawa values differences and enables everyone to belong, contribute, succeed, and demonstrate their full potential.
 We hire great people for great opportunities 
 Please visit our website https://www.yokogawa.com/nl/about/careers/ to discover more about our employees’ stories and the various career possibilities we offer.
